panel.name: instances_section

check_box.label: Edit clones

check_box.tool_tip: Edit clones in world: click a clone to select it, drag to move it on the ground, Shift-drag to turn it, click empty ground to re-place the selection, Delete removes it. Esc (or unchecking) hands the camera back. Spinners below stay the precision path

scroll_list.name: ghost_list

combo_box.name: source_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Whose body the new clone copies: you, or any cast member

combo_box.name: clone_type_combo
combo_box.tool_tip:
Persistent type for newly added clones.
Overlay clone: A light copy that re-draws the source avatar's own mesh at another spot. It mirrors what the source is doing, or holds a pose you freeze. Cheapest; best for crowds and echoes. Drawn after fog and haze, so atmosphere doesn't touch it.
Entity clone: A real avatar that exists only in your viewer, with its own skeleton. It can play its own animations (copy the source, a chosen animation, true mirror, or auto-animate), and has its own scale, physics, eye motion, speed and stepping. Lit, fogged and hazed like a real avatar. Heavier per copy.

button.name: btn_ghost_dup

button.label: Delete

button.label: Refresh

button.tool_tip: Re-sync this entity clone to its source's current appearance and worn attachments

text.name: ghost_type
text.tool_tip:
The kind of the selected clone, and its state.
Overlay clone: A light copy that re-draws the source avatar's own mesh at another spot. It mirrors what the source is doing, or holds a pose you freeze. Cheapest; best for crowds and echoes. Drawn after fog and haze, so atmosphere doesn't touch it.
Entity clone: A real avatar that exists only in your viewer, with its own skeleton. It can play its own animations (copy the source, a chosen animation, true mirror, or auto-animate), and has its own scale, physics, eye motion, speed and stepping. Lit, fogged and hazed like a real avatar. Heavier per copy.

panel.name: pose_section

button.label: Grab pose now
button.name: btn_freeze
button.tool_tip: FREEZE: snapshot the source's current pose into this clone (worn mesh + attachment placement). The clone holds it while the live body keeps animating. Known limits: flexi tails/skirts keep their live physics motion, and legacy system-mesh eyeballs are not part of the clone

button.label: Follow live
button.name: btn_live
button.tool_tip: Drop the frozen pose; the clone mirrors the source's live animation again

check_box.label: Hold on src change
check_box.name: mirror_hold_check
check_box.tool_tip: MIRROR mode: keep clones playing their last bento + animesh animation through a transient source change (outfit re-rez, brief de-rez, out-of-view imposter, or AO gap) instead of stopping. A real switch to a different animation still mirrors normally. Off = faithful live mirror (a source change or full stop stops the clone too).

check_box.label: Repeat held
check_box.name: mirror_repeat_held_check
check_box.tool_tip: Needs Hold on src change. While a clone's animesh is HELD (source detached/gone), replay each finished one-shot animesh animation so a script-retriggered tail or idle keeps cycling instead of freezing. Looping animations are untouched. Functional repetition, not seamless: a small seam per cycle, and a deliberate one-shot action will repeat too (hence off by default).

combo_box.name: drive_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Entity animation drive: mirror its source's animations, play a local animation asset, hold the current pose, or TRUE mirror (copy the source's final pose incl. gaze/IK/expressions every frame; heavier), or Reflect (left/right motion mirror; geometry and props stay on their sides)

check_box.label: Chaos
check_box.name: chaos_check

slider.name: chaos_slider
slider.tool_tip: Chaos amount (0..1); stable for this clone's instance id

button.name: reset_chaos

combo_box.name: reflect_plane_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Reflect plane: Fixed holds the captured bisector. Live follows the bisector: yaw turns at twice the bearing rate and whirls near the clone. Live is unavailable with Mirror position.

check_box.label: Mirror position
check_box.name: reflect_position_check
